inputs.objects: destination GridObjects with exact GridObjectAddress and resolved ItemID when available
inputs.definitionDispositionByItemId: optional Core-resolved progression-risk disposition records; WEP must not reinterpret raw Mission/Item flags
inputs.scopeIndex: optional existing Core current-v1.25 scope records used inside Core to derive negative risk only

negativeSemantics.activeExactAddressReference: veto identity-changing mutation and protect destination overwrite
negativeSemantics.historicalReferenceOnly: no active-ownership veto from that historical record
negativeSemantics.isMissionItem: Core risk evidence -> QUEST_OWNED for negative protection only
negativeSemantics.forPuzzleOnly: Core risk evidence -> PUZZLE_OWNED for negative protection only
negativeSemantics.explicitGridEditRestrictionWithoutStrong: Core risk evidence -> UNKNOWN_OWNERSHIP for negative protection only

wepContract.consumerRule: WEP consumes operationVetoes/reasonCodes and may block; WEP may not turn a no-veto record into positive permission.
